claims.text: Mild to moderate (no serious neuro, renal, GI or cardiac dz): corticosteroids + methotrexate or azathioprine
claims.quote: For mild to moderate disease but no serious neurologic, renal, gastrointestinal, or cardiac manifestations, corticosteroids plus methotrexate or azathioprine may be used.

claims.text: Severe (neuro, renal, GI or cardiac dz): cyclophosphamide + corticosteroids
claims.quote: For severe disease with neurologic, renal, gastrointestinal, or cardiac manifestations, cyclophosphamide plus corticosteroids may improve outcome.

claims.text: Hepatitis B–related PAN: antiviral therapy + a short course of corticosteroids (avoid high doses > 20 mg/day: HBV reactivation)
claims.quote: Treatment is aimed at rapidly suppressing inflammation and antiviral therapy. A short course of corticosteroids is used for a few weeks, but high doses (> 20 mg/day) should be avoided to minimize the risk of hepatitis B virus reactivation.

claims.text: Hepatitis B–related PAN: plasma exchange sometimes, until HBeAg converts to anti-HBe or recovery is sustained for 2 to 3 months
claims.quote: Plasma exchanges are sometimes done until the hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) converts to hepatitis B e antibody (anti-HBe) or until clinical recovery is sustained for 2 to 3 months (2).
